failureHistory.issue: Engine compilation rejected constructor member ordering
failureHistory.resolution: Initializer order corrected; subsequent audited builds passed

failureHistory.issue: Early native menu attempts timed out or lost foreground during metadata refresh
failureHistory.resolution: Preserve pending read requests, make hidden helpers explicitly nonactivating, and wait for the fixture window to be foreground

failureHistory.issue: Native popup guard was unavailable after early startup registration
failureHistory.resolution: Register guard again on live tab registration/selection; real popup and permission tests then passed

failureHistory.issue: Pending new-tab selection retired the global dock before browser creation
failureHistory.resolution: Preserve the dock only during same-workspace pending creation, while the native selected-source guard rejects old-source requests

failureHistory.issue: Existing-popup check observed popup dismissal during the foreground-readiness run
failureHistory.resolution: Retained failed evidence; fresh untouched-window final run passed all 36 checks
